subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown (figures 1 to 3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having ‘6’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a86fc08965c3d2ca91860bede436d39de3a467d917d3a4fccc41aba926cc9c96.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 1, 2, 3 and 4 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 6 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee9565b124035dbded1e9b6e91013f9b06f84549492c65cd0b849257f5729bcf.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 3

2 → 4

5 → 6

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "5".

Hence, the correct answer is "5".
